data.title: KSrelief Concludes Volunteer Urology Surgery, Crisis and Disaster Management Projects in Port Sudan
data.content:
Port Sudan, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) concluded two volunteer projects in urological surgery and crisis and disaster management training in Port Sudan, Sudan, conducted from November 11 to 18, with the participation of 14 volunteers from various specialties, in cooperation with the Zmzam Health Association in Makkah Region.
    During the campaign, KSrelief's volunteer medical team examined 244 individuals and performed 89 urological surgeries, all of which were successful. Meanwhile, 64 individuals received training in crisis and disaster management.
    These initiatives are part of the volunteer projects and programs implemented by Saudi Arabia through its humanitarian arm, KSrelief, to assist the Sudanese people and alleviate their suffering amid the ongoing humanitarian crisis.
    
    -- SPA
